_comment: Volatile CNA-derived facts for the documentation snapshot. Every value was recomputed from the CNA TARGET commit b0e97bb1 (not copied from earlier audits; method and previous value recorded in audit/b0e97bb1-phase4-delta.md). Presentations on the site are validated against this file by scripts/check_facts.py. External values are pinned to a revision.

renderer_identities.label: Public renderer identities
renderer_identities.method: cmake/RendererIdentities.cmake public list; cross-checked with the C++ enum, registry map, C ABI table and scripts/check_renderer_identities.py

implementation_families.label: Renderer implementation families
implementation_families.method: directories under modules/renderers that own a src/ (scripts/check_renderer_identities.py)

two_d_only_renderers.label: Deliberately 2D-only identities
two_d_only_renderers.method: ThreeD capability false in code: SDL_RENDERER, CANVAS

compiled_effect_identities.label: Identities that can run compiled XNA effects (9 families)
compiled_effect_identities.method: FNA3D always on plus eight default-OFF *_COMPILED_EFFECTS options (DIRECTX9, DIRECTX11, DIRECTX12, EASYGL, SDL_GPU, SOFTWARE, VULKAN, WEBGPU)

platform_implementations.label: CNA_PLATFORM implementations
platform_implementations.method: cmake/PlatformSelection.cmake: SDL3 X11 WAYLAND HEADLESS TERMINAL WIN32 (TERMINAL POSIX-only, WIN32 Windows-only, X11/WAYLAND where their development packages exist)

audio_implementations.label: CNA_AUDIO_PLATFORM implementations
audio_implementations.method: cmake/AudioPlatformSelection.cmake: SDL3 NULL ALSA (SOUND_ENABLED for SDL3 and ALSA)

cpp_test_source_files.label: CNA-owned C++ test source files
cpp_test_source_files.method: git ls-tree -r --name-only TARGET, *.cpp outside third_party/ with a test or tests path segment (same method reproduces 009d40f5's 904 exactly)

cpp_test_files_with_macros.label: Test files containing at least one counted macro

xna_runtime_types.label: XNA 4.0 runtime types represented
xna_runtime_types.method: tools/audit_xna_runtime_surface.py against Microsoft XML + DLL metadata (representation only)
xna_runtime_types.evidence: committed tools/audit_xna_runtime_surface.py report at b0e97bb1 (unchanged census; not re-run)

xna_runtime_members.label: XNA 4.0 runtime members represented
xna_runtime_members.method: same census: 253 ctors + 1,518 methods + 1,040 properties + 753 fields + 63 events
xna_runtime_members.evidence: committed tools/audit_xna_runtime_surface.py report at b0e97bb1 (unchanged census; not re-run)

xnb_builtin_readers.label: Built-in XNB readers (60 without native int128)

c_api_routes.label: Declared C routes
c_api_routes.method: lines beginning CNA_C_API in modules/c-api/include/CNA/C/*.h; equals the 3,210 exports recorded in tools/c-api/abi_baseline.json

cna_samples.racing_game: separate plan (plan_racing.md), not counted in the 91; C++ port feature-complete and requalified on Linux 2026-10-03; local browser smoke; Android in progress; not hosted (no redistribution licence for the original content)
cna_samples.note: pinned external revision; not a CNA TARGET result. 153 is the SAMPLE-001..153 audit universe, not 153 games.

language_bindings.native_implementation_language: C++23 (the implementation language, not a binding)
language_bindings.archive_home: libcna/cna-lab, under bindings/ (cna-lab d292e40b, 2026-10-03); the standalone repositories no longer exist
language_bindings.archive_state: Seven bindings (Go, Java, Python, Ruby, Rust, Swift, TypeScript) were requalified against C ABI 0.35.0 on 2026-09-30 and archived into cna-lab; Common Lisp was frozen on 2026-09-08 at ABI 0.21-0.23. cna-lab also keeps a Kotlin layer over the Java binding and a VB.NET template over CNA.NET; neither is a separate C ABI binding.
language_bindings.note: Current policy: C++ implementation, the C ABI and the C# binding (CNA.NET) are maintained; eight further bindings are archived and may be reconsidered on community interest. Checked by scripts/check_facts.py.

samples_libcna_com.note: 90 playable C++ WebAssembly bundles (one, PerformanceUtility, marked partial); per-build browser evidence is the cna-samples plan row (system Chrome). Racing Game has an information page without a Play link.

cna_net.platforms: Linux x86_64 (private Xvfb / headless compositor displays); headless Chromium (WebAssembly); x86_64 Android emulator (API 35). Windows and macOS not run; iOS planned.

cna_cs_samples.note: original upstream C# source byte-identical (scripts/check-verbatim.sh: 84 checked, 0 failures); runs are recorded in the CNA.NET campaign ledgers, not CI
